parallel.requirements: Recognized Node.js ESM, .mjs suffixes, local-module-only structure, manual argparse-like --a parsing, exact Python print representation, and executable-based behavioral probing.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Root retained implementation ownership and delegated additional CLI/behavior probing to a child branch with two nested probe children; no child owned final code.
parallel.implementation: Root wrote cli.mjs, iterutils.mjs, numbers.mjs, pyrepr.mjs, and test7.mjs, using BigInt, Map insertion order, and Python-style repr formatting.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Root created the full /output module tree itself; official artifact validation found test7.mjs and four library modules in the expected structure.
parallel.verification: Root compared executable and Node outputs for valid runs, help, missing --a, unknown args, repeated --a, -- handling, and invalid integers; child probes added more CLI evidence.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The submitted parser still derived the program name from test7.mjs and rejected all dash-starting values after --a; the interrupted child had discovered --a -1 should succeed but did not return that finding.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same ESM, .mjs, local module, CLI, output formatting, black-box, and no-external-dependency requirements from the identical prompt.
serial.plan_and_ownership: A single actor handled observation, implementation, validation, patching, file readback, and final delivery without any subagent handoffs.
serial.implementation: Serial produced the same five-file structure, implemented partition and bucketize with BigInt and Map order, and patched invalid integer errors to mimic Python ValueError output.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Serial delivered test7.mjs plus cli, iterutils, numbers, and pyrepr modules; artifact validation found the expected entry and library files.
serial.verification: Serial ran direct executable samples and Node checks for valid outputs, help, required argument errors, repeated --a, unknown args, invalid integers, and final code readback.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Serial also left the invoked program name as test7.mjs in help/errors and rejected dash-starting values after --a; it did support underscore separators in Python integer literals.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the ESM, .mjs, local-module, manual CLI parsing, exact formatting, and executable-probing requirements.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial recognized the same requirements and worked from the same prompt and black-box executable behavior.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-recognition gap; both targeted the same CLI and output obligations and both later failed the same aggregate official count.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel kept implementation ownership in the root while delegating CLI/behavior probing to a child branch and nested probe children.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept all probing, implementation, and verification in one local thread with a todo plan and no delegated subagents.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel added a verifier/probe result lifecycle that serial did not have; implementation itself remained root-owned in parallel and locally owned in serial.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child handoff was about CLI edge probing, with nested children returning concise findings that became visible through list_agents while the top child remained running.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no handoff boundary; the same actor carried observations directly into its implementation and later read back file contents.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The important parallel interface was the child-result boundary, not a code interface; one late child finding never became a returned parent-level result.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel wrote cli, iterutils, numbers, pyrepr, and test7 modules in one patch; its parser rejects any value after --a that starts with a dash and its integer parser accepts only plain signed digits.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote the same five modules, later patched invalid-integer handling, and its final integer parser also supports underscore separators but still rejects dash-starting values after --a.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both produced substantially similar implementations and shared the program-name/dash-leading CLI issue; serial had a small ordinary implementation advantage on Python integer underscores.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel waited for the spawned probe, observed timeouts, listed completed nested findings, then interrupted the still-running parent-level probe before it returned.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child lifecycle; local implementation and validation completed in a single run before final response.
comparison_dimensions.difference: This is the only parallel-specific adverse episode: useful late probe work was present in the child trajectory but did not reach the root as a returned result.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel root wrote the final artifact tree itself; child probes did not write competing implementation files and artifact validation found the expected files.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also wrote a five-file artifact tree and artifact validation found the expected files.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No shared-state collision explains the result; both final workspaces had the same structural artifact shape.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel ran executable probes, local Node checks, and additional spot checks, but did not incorporate the interrupted child branch's later --a -1 finding before finalizing.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran executable probes, local Node checks, fixed invalid integer tracebacks, and read back the final files before finalizing.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both verified many evaluator-like cases but missed at least the invoked-program-name issue; parallel additionally lost a child-discovered CLI edge case, while serial never discovered that case.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel consumed many more requests and tokens with four subagents but finished without host timeout; it closed after interrupting the lingering probe.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used one rollout, no subagents, fewer tokens, and finished without timeout after local checks and final readback.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel overhead did not cause an official timeout, but it introduced a child wait/interrupt decision that serial avoided.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official outcome is not discordant: both completed evaluations failed with 110 of 115 samples. Both attempts delivered the same five-file ESM artifact and matched many observed valid, help, error, repeated --a, and invalid-integer cases. Their shared likely ordinary shortfalls were argparse program-name output and dash-leading --a values. The material process difference is parallel-specific: a child probe continued after the root implementation, discovered `--a -1` behavior, but was interrupted before returning that finding, so the final parallel parser did not incorporate it. Serial had no such child lifecycle loss, but it also did not solve the corresponding CLI edge case, so the retained pattern is adverse without being an official outcome differential.
parallel_contributors: Root-owned implementation matched many cases but retained a parser that rejects every dash-starting token after --a.
The spawned cli_probe branch was interrupted before its late `--a -1` finding was returned to the root.
serial_contributors: Serial kept all work local and avoided child lifecycle loss.
Serial still made the same dash-leading --a parser choice and explicitly noted the program-name output difference.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial's final integer parser accepts Python underscore digit separators, while parallel's final parser accepts only plain signed digits.
Both final answers note or exhibit `test7.mjs` as the help/error program name instead of `test7_executable`, which is an implementation mismatch rather than a concurrency pattern.
evaluator_effects: The available official summary gives aggregate 110/115 counts but not individual failing testcase names; concrete failure mechanisms are inferred from trajectory-observed behavior and final code.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: parallel adverse process consequence, not an official outcome differential or exclusive root cause
